entries.reasoning: The Northwind MSA (9.2 and S1.2) contains an absolute assignment of Intellectual Property Rights in PipeKit to Northwind Logistics upon payment. This conflicts with § 6.3 of the Rheinwerk agreement, where AtliQ warrants it is the 'sole owner' of PipeKit, and § 6.1, which describes PipeKit as AtliQ's 'proprietary' tool.

incomingClauses.quote: Supplier warrants that it is the sole owner of all intellectual property rights in PipeKit, that it is entitled to grant the rights set out in § 6.2, and that PipeKit and its use under this Agreement do not infringe any rights of third parties.

Supplier shall deliver the services using its proprietary data-pipeline accelerator "PipeKit", comprising reusable ingestion connectors, transformation templates, data quality rule libraries and orchestration modules. PipeKit shall be incorporated into the Work Results to reduce implementation time and cost.

Supplier hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use, reproduce, modify and operate PipeKit as incorporated in the Work Results, for the purposes of operating, maintaining and further developing the Platform, including for the benefit of Client's customers.

entries.suggestedChange: Redline § 6.3 to remove the warranty of 'sole ownership' and replace it with a warranty that Supplier has obtained all necessary rights and licenses to grant the rights set out in § 6.2; additionally, verify if a license-back was obtained from Northwind Logistics.
entries.impact: The warranty of sole ownership of PipeKit in § 6.3 collides with the absolute assignment of PipeKit IP to Northwind Logistics, which remains live perpetually.

covenants.quote: Except for PipeKit, Client shall acquire the exclusive, perpetual, transferable and unrestricted right of use in all Work Results created specifically for Client, upon full payment of the relevant Milestone Fee.
covenants.impact: AtliQ is restricted from reusing any code or configurations developed specifically for Rheinwerk for any other client, which may limit the reuse of non-PipeKit templates in the industrial analytics sector.
